extracted.name: Bloody spritz
extracted.description: Mix up a refreshing spritz cocktail with smooth whisky, fruity peach and orange flavours, and sharp blood orange. Simply shake, top up and serve
instruction_lines: Put the ice in a cocktail shaker and then add all the ingredients, except the soda and garnishes. Shake all the ingredients until chilled and well mixed, and then double strain into a highball glass filled with ice. Top up with soda and garnish with a blood orange wheel, if you like.
